title: Passive parameter table
row_meaning: one row per (layer, genetic type) class

fields.name: cm_reference
fields.meaning: which capacitance the stored cm refers to
fields.note: the passive-fitting pipeline applies the spine correction INSIDE the model (set_passive sets cm = Cm * F_multiplier), so the optimiser returns the intrinsic, shaft-referenced value. Applying a shaft-referenced cm to a pruned morphology together with F derived from C8.4 is correct and double-counts nothing; applying an EFFECTIVE cm the same way double-counts. The two differ by roughly 1.7 to 2.4 and there is no way to recover which one a bare number is.

assertions: F is applied at model-build time from phi and is never folded into the stored cm (invariant I-17)
for every passive class: tau_m = C_m R_m in the declared range (invariant I-10)
